votes.plain_language: This bill provides appropriations to several federal departments and agencies for the remainder of FY2026 and provides continuing FY2026 appropriations for the Department of Homeland Security through February 13, 2026. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7148)
votes.bill_title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7148 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026) is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment sought to prohibit the use of funds for certain community funding projects.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7148)
votes.bill_title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7148 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026) is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment sought to prohibit the use of funds to implement section 24220 of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, including any requirements enabling or supporting vehicle "kill switch" technology, and to prohibit federal spending for the execution or enforcement of such authorities.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Passage — Making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes (H R 7147)
votes.bill_title: Homeland Security and Further Additional Continuing Appropriations Act, 2026.
votes.plain_language: This bill provides continuing FY2026 appropriations to the Department of Homeland Security through May 22, 2026. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Passage — Financial Services and General Government and National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2026 (H R 7006)
votes.bill_title: Financial Services and General Government and National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This bill provides FY2026 appropriations to several federal departments and agencies for activities and programs related to financial services, general government, national security, the administration of foreign affairs, and foreign assistance. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7006)
votes.bill_title: Financial Services and General Government and National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7006 is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment sought to eliminate funding for the National Endowment for Democracy.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7006)
votes.bill_title: Financial Services and General Government and National Security, Department of State, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7006 is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment sought to reduce the District of Columbia District and Appeals Court funding by 20% and to strike the salary and expense funding for Judges Boasberg's and Judge Boardman's staffs.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — AGOA Extension Act (H R 6500)
votes.bill_title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027
votes.plain_language: This bill provides continuing FY2027 appropriations for federal agencies and extends various expiring programs and authorities. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Passage — Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026 (H R 6938)
votes.bill_title: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: This bill provides FY2026 appropriations to several federal departments and agencies for activities and programs related to commerce, law enforcement, science, energy and water development, public lands, and the environment. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Retaining Divisions B and C — Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026 (H R 6938)
votes.bill_title: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: H.R. 6938 combines three FY2026 spending bills: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment. The House voted separately on whether to keep parts of the bill. This vote was on keeping Divisions B and C. A Yea keeps them in the bill; a Nay would remove them.

votes.question: On Retaining Division A — Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026 (H R 6938)
votes.bill_title: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026
votes.plain_language: H.R. 6938 combines three FY2026 spending bills: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment. The House voted separately on whether to keep parts of the bill. This vote was on keeping Division A. A Yea keeps it in the bill; a Nay would remove it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — KIDS Act (H R 7757)
votes.bill_title: KIDS Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires specified online platforms to establish safeguards for minors. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Small Business Technological Advancement Act (H R 915)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Technological Advancement Act
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes the Small Business Administration to finance, under its 7(a) loan program, business software or cloud computing services, including tools that use artificial intelligence. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act (H R 7401)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Administration employees who take part in originating, reviewing, or approving agency loans to certify in writing that they have no conflict of interest with the loan and to disclose any conflict that arises later. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act (S 3971)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act
votes.plain_language: This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies the Small Business Innovation Research program, the Small Business Technology Transfer program, and related pilot programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — AI for Main Street Act (H R 5764)
votes.bill_title: AI for Main Street Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Main Street Parity Act (H R 5763)
votes.bill_title: Main Street Parity Act
votes.plain_language: This bill lessens the financing requirements for certain Small Business Administration loans to small businesses for plant acquisition, construction, conversion, or expansion, including the acquisition of land. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.
